title: Grand Atlas Loop (Morocco option)
summary: Both great passes and the Anti-Atlas in between — a closed loop from Marrakech. One of five candidate itineraries for the same late-October 2026 Morocco trip — 660 km and 7,450 m over 7 days, high point 2,260 m. Leave comments to argue for or against this one.
season: Best Oct–Apr · avoid Jun–Aug (Ouarzazate side regularly 40 °C+)

days.title: Marrakech → Ouirgane
days.summary: Easy opener. Flat to Tahannaout, then the valley tilts up through Asni.

days.title: Ouirgane → Oulad Berhil
days.summary: Tizi n'Test — 30 km of climbing on a narrow balcony road, then a 60 km descent. Carry everything; the south side has almost nothing.

days.title: Oulad Berhil → Taliouine
days.summary: Souss valley, gently uphill all day into the saffron country.

days.title: Taliouine → Tazenakht
days.summary: Tizi n'Taghatine, ~1,880 m. Empty, high, exposed — the quietest day of the loop.

days.title: Tazenakht → Ouarzazate
days.summary: Desert plateau. Wind is the whole story here, not the gradient.

days.title: Ouarzazate → Telouet
days.summary: Aït Benhaddou, then the old kasbah road climbing steadily to Telouet.

days.title: Telouet → Marrakech
days.summary: Tizi n'Tichka from the quiet eastern side, then roughly 100 km of descent into the city.

title: Marrakech Climbing Camp (Morocco option)
summary: Five days, two bases, no luggage — the biggest climbs the High Atlas has near a city. One of five candidate itineraries for the same late-October 2026 Morocco trip — 525 km and 7,000 m over 5 days, high point 2,620 m. Leave comments to argue for or against this one.
season: Best Mar–May and Oct–Nov · Oukaïmeden can hold snow into March

days.title: Marrakech loop
days.summary: Oukaïmeden, 2,620 m — the hardest single climb in the range: ~40 km of ascent, the last 15 at 7–8%. Closest thing to an Alpine col in Morocco.

days.title: Marrakech loop
days.summary: Recovery loop on the foothill road via the lake. Rolling, never steep.

days.title: Marrakech → Ouirgane
days.summary: Transfer ride to the second base. Short enough to do after a late start.

days.title: Ouirgane loop
days.summary: Tizi n'Test out and back. Climb it in the morning, descend before the heat.

days.title: Ouirgane → Marrakech
days.summary: Back to the city the long way round, through Amizmiz.

title: Atlas & Gorges (Morocco option)
summary: Point to point over Tichka, then east along the Valley of Roses into Dadès and Todra. One of five candidate itineraries for the same late-October 2026 Morocco trip — 520 km and 6,300 m over 6 days, high point 2,260 m. Leave comments to argue for or against this one.
season: Best Oct–Apr · the gorges are high and cold at night, the plateau hot by day

days.title: Marrakech → Taddert
days.summary: Flat out of the city, then the Tichka road starts climbing in earnest at Aït Ourir.

days.title: Taddert → Ouarzazate
days.summary: Tizi n'Tichka before breakfast (2,260 m, ~20 km from Taddert), then all downhill to the desert.

days.title: Ouarzazate → Boumalne Dadès
days.summary: The Valley of Roses road — palmeries, kasbahs, steady false flat east.

days.title: Boumalne Dadès loop
days.summary: Dadès Gorge out and back, through the hairpins above Tamlalt to Msemrir at ~2,000 m. The best road of the trip.

days.title: Boumalne Dadès → Tinghir
days.summary: Deliberately short. Half day on the bike, half day off it.

days.title: Tinghir loop
days.summary: Todra Gorge and up to Tamtattouchte — 300 m rock walls, then open high country.

title: Anti-Atlas Loop (Morocco option)
summary: Agadir, Tafraoute and the Ameln valley — quiet roads, granite, winter sun. One of five candidate itineraries for the same late-October 2026 Morocco trip — 470 km and 5,600 m over 5 days, high point 1,500 m. Leave comments to argue for or against this one.
season: Best Nov–Mar · the only one of these that works in deep winter

days.title: Agadir → Aït Baha
days.summary: Out of the coastal sprawl quickly, then rolling argan country.

days.title: Aït Baha → Tafraoute
days.summary: The hard day: Tizi Mlil at ~1,500 m on an empty road, then down into the Tafraoute bowl.

days.title: Tafraoute loop
days.summary: Ameln valley loop under the Jbel El Kest wall, over Tizi n'Tarakatine, past the painted rocks.

days.title: Tafraoute → Tiznit
days.summary: West over the last of the granite, then a long drop to the plain.

days.title: Tiznit → Agadir
days.summary: Coast road home past Aglou and the Massa estuary. Watch the afternoon headwind.

title: Alpine-grade (Morocco option)
summary: Built to match the daily load of the French Alps traverse — 600 km and 8,700 m over 6 days, i.e. 100 km and 1450 m a day against the Alps’ 100 km and 1,662 m. Marrakech-based: Oukaïmeden, then Tizi n’Test from Ouirgane, then the Tichka road to Taddert and back. Assembled by recombining stages from the other options rather than surveying new roads.
season: Best Mar–May and Oct–Nov · Oukaïmeden can hold snow into March

days.title: Marrakech → Oukaïmeden loop
days.summary: Oukaïmeden, 2,620 m — the hardest single climb in the range: ~40 km of ascent, the last 15 at 7–8%. Closest thing to an Alpine col in Morocco.

days.title: Marrakech → Ouirgane
days.summary: Transfer ride to the second base. Short enough to do after a late start.

days.title: Ouirgane → Tizi n’Test loop
days.summary: Tizi n'Test out and back. Climb it in the morning, descend before the heat.

days.title: Ouirgane → Marrakech
days.summary: Back to the city the long way round, through Amizmiz.

days.title: Marrakech → Taddert
days.summary: Flat out of the city, then the Tichka road starts climbing in earnest at Aït Ourir.

days.title: Taddert → Marrakech
days.summary: Flat out of the city, then the Tichka road starts climbing in earnest at Aït Ourir. Ridden in the reverse direction.

title: Around Manaslu
summary: Ten days trekking the Manaslu approach, 21–30 October 2025 — 160.5 km and 7,606 m from Machhakhola up the Budhi Gandaki to Samdo, with an acclimatisation day to Manaslu Base Camp at 4,855 m, then back out the same valley. These tracks do not cross Larke La: Samdo is the furthest point and day 8 turns around.

days.title: Machhakhola → Jagat
days.summary: Into the Budhi Gandaki gorge — 18.5 km and 803 m, climbing from 888 m to Jagat at 1,352 m.

days.title: Jagat → Deng
days.summary: Longer and steadier up the valley, 19.6 km to Deng at 1,877 m.

days.title: Deng → Namrung
days.summary: The valley narrows and steepens: 1,243 m of climbing over 16.6 km to Namrung at 2,647 m.

days.title: Namrung → Shyala
days.summary: Through Lho with the first big mountain views, finishing at Shyala at 3,522 m.
highlights: Over 3,500 m for the first time

days.title: Shyala → Samagaon
days.summary: Short on paper but the track climbs to 4,055 m on a side excursion before dropping into Samagaon at 3,537 m.

days.title: Samagaon → Manaslu Base Camp → Samagaon
days.summary: Acclimatisation day: out and back from Samagaon to Manaslu Base Camp at 4,855 m — the highest point of the whole trek and its biggest climbing day at 1,356 m.
highlights: High point 4,855 m — highest of the trek

days.title: Samagaon → Samdo
days.summary: Shortest day of the trek at 8.1 km, up to Samdo at 3,869 m — the furthest point reached.

days.title: Samdo → Lho
days.summary: Turning back down the valley, 15.6 km of almost pure descent to Lho at 3,181 m.

days.title: Lho → Bihi
days.summary: Longest day of the trek: 21.9 km retracing the approach down to Bihi at 2,163 m.

days.title: Bihi → Chisopani
days.summary: Last day out, 15.3 km down to Chisopani at 1,692 m.

title: Around Cyprus
summary: Six days riding a full loop of Cyprus, 30 November to 5 December 2025 — 618.9 km and 7,024 m, anticlockwise from Peyia over the Troodos, along the Karpas peninsula and back down the south coast. Recorded on Strava, cleaned and simplified for the web.

days.title: Peyia → Pedoulas
days.summary: Straight off the coast and up into the Troodos — 2,131 m of climbing to Pedoulas at 1,248 m, the hardest day of the loop by a distance.

days.title: Pedoulas → Templos
days.summary: Long descent off the mountains to the north coast. A late start and only 500 m of climbing — the recovery day.

days.title: Templos → Rizokarpaso
days.summary: Out along the Karpas peninsula. Flat and exposed — nothing above 158 m all day.

days.title: Rizokarpaso → Ayia Napa
days.summary: Back down the peninsula and around to the south-east coast. A short burst of GPS jitter has been removed.

days.title: Ayia Napa → Pano Lefkara
days.summary: Shortest day, turning inland off the coast and climbing gently to Lefkara.

days.title: Pano Lefkara → Peyia
days.summary: The long way home: 131.8 km and 1,853 m back across to Peyia, closing the loop. Started at 05:31.

title: French Alps traverse
summary: Six days by bike from the Massif des Maures to Grenoble — 599.8 km and 9,972 m of climbing, crossing from the Mediterranean hinterland into the high Alps. Tracks are the recorded Garmin files, cleaned and simplified for the web.

days.title: La Garde-Freinet → Castellane
days.summary: Out of the Massif des Maures and into the Gorges du Verdon approach. The longest low-altitude day — the climbing is constant but never goes above 1,000 m.

days.title: Castellane → Barcelonnette
days.summary: First real altitude of the trip: the route tops out at 2,246 m before dropping into the Ubaye valley.

days.title: Barcelonnette → Briançon
days.summary: Shortest day by distance, and still 1,617 m of climbing. Tops out at 2,115 m.

days.title: Briançon → Le Bourg-d'Oisans
days.summary: The high point of the whole trip at 2,641 m. GPS dropped out several times on this stage (tunnels and deep valley sections) — the track runs straight across those gaps rather than guessing a line, and a short burst of GPS jitter has been removed.
highlights: High point 2,641 m — highest of the trip

days.title: Le Bourg-d'Oisans → Albertville
days.summary: Long valley day north through the Maurienne side, 108.6 km with a 1,926 m high point.

days.title: Albertville → Grenoble
days.summary: Biggest day of the trip: 117.5 km and 2,025 m of climbing to finish, all of it below 1,350 m.
